name: team_planning_set_plan_scope
description: Set which units a Team Planning plan covers: unit_ids, each with everything under it, or none for the whole organisation. Widening is always allowed. Narrowing is refused while the plan holds a change about a person, unit, position or budget line the narrower plan would leave out; the refusal names those changes and counts any it can't name. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

unit_ids.description: the units it covers; none for the whole organisation
